title: NEON Biorepository Benthic Macroinvertebrate Collection (Taxonomy Reference Collection)
description: Individual macroinvertebrate specimens retained as taxonomic reference material from samples collected from wadeable streams, rivers, and lakes. Collected samples are separated into fluid-preserved macroinvertebrates, fluid-preserved chironomids, fluid-preserved oligochaetes, and slide-mounted chironomids and oligochaetes. Taxonomic identifications are generated from subsamples of each group. This sample type contains macroinvertebrate specimens retained as taxonomic reference material from subsample analysis. Sampling 3 sampling bouts per year (spring, summer, fall) 8 locations at each NEON site 5 in dominant habitat type (wadeable stream) or littoral area (lake and river) 3 in sub-dominant habitat type (wadeable streams) or pelagic area (lakes and rivers) 11 samples collected per bout total 8 morphology samples (1 per location) 3 DNA samples (3 dominant/littoral locations) Bouts 1 & 3 DNA samples archived unprocessed Bout 2 samples extracted and sequenced Methods Habitat-appropriate sampling gear (e.g., Surber, Hess, corer, kicknet, D-frame sweep, petite ponar) Samples collected from natural substrate surface Preservation Samples shipped to taxonomist for sorting and identification into general macroinvertebrates, chironomids, and oligochaetes Taxonomic reference samples can be prepared and archived at the end of a taxonomist's contract period Preserved in 95% ethanol Small volume of glycerol added prior to October 2021 Maintained in temperature- and humidity-controlled storage
